steps.title: Define API Schema
steps.description: Create api_schema.json setting backend to false since it's a standalone landing page.

steps.title: Build HTML Structure
steps.description: Create index.html featuring an enhanced modern navbar, hero section with dynamic visual elements, interactive feature cards, pricing tiers, interactive FAQ accordion, testimonials, and contact section.

steps.title: Add Responsive Styling with Tailwind CSS
steps.description: Style components with Tailwind CSS utility classes, glowing gradient backdrops, smooth transitions, and custom styling in style.css.

steps.description: Add script.js for mobile menu toggling, smooth scrolling, FAQ toggles, interactive pricing toggle, and form submission feedback.

steps.title: Building landingpagepro
steps.description: Finalize all components, polish animations, and ensure ultra-responsive landing page functionality.
